title: Deal Hunting
intro: Shopping bots are well supplied and easy to evaluate, because the claim is checkable: either the price dropped or it did not. The listings cover watching a specific item, hunting a category against a budget, tracking flights and points, and comparison across sites. The ones worth having share a trait — they wait. A bot that reports the current price every day is a subscription to information you already had; a bot that stays silent until something crosses the threshold you set is doing the job. Be deliberate about purchasing. Several templates in this category describe bidding or buying when a target is hit, and an agent authorised to spend money is a category of risk distinct from everything else on this site. Watching, comparing and alerting covers most of the value with none of that exposure.
